title: AIxDaily
overview_zh: 今日精选：AI × Chem 16 项，AI × Bio 14 项，AI × Math 15 项，AI Voices 10 项，Engineering 3 项。今日五频道以预印本和公开观点为主，未见可确认的同行评议论文。化学聚焦蛋白语言模型、结构基础模型与 Atom-JEPA；生物覆盖知识图谱查询、药物相互作用和跨物种 miRNA 基准。数学讨论零知识审计、Lean 证明及数值证据。AI Voices 汇集模型能力、生成式药物设计和生物数据合作观点；工程频道呈现 GitHub Trending 软件项目，因 Releases 源超时，未确认新版本发布。

items.title: Protein Language Model-Conditioned Graph Neural Networks for Multitask GPCR Ligand Activity Prediction
items.abstract_or_text: Predicting ligand activity across G protein-coupled receptors (GPCRs) requires models that capture both molecular structure and receptor-specific information while remaining robust to chemical and target-domain shift. We developed a multimodal graph neural network that combines explicit ligand molecular graphs with frozen protein language model representations of GPCR sequences and jointly predicts quantitative pActivity and binary activity. The model was trained on 271,739 curated ligand-GPCR pairs spanning 183,694 ligands and 216 human GPCRs and evaluated using random, Bemis-Murcko scaffold, and strict cold-ligand partitions. With ESM-2 650M receptor embeddings, the selected model achieved mean absolute errors of 0.513 {+/-} 0.006, 0.540 {+/-} 0.006, and 0.641 {+/-} 0.005 pActivity units under random, cold-ligand, and scaffold evaluation, respectively, substantially outperforming a protein-aware fixed-feature multilayer perceptron and consistently improving quantitative prediction over a matched GINE reference. Removing receptor embeddings markedly degraded both regression and classification, whereas differences among ESM-2 35M, ESM-2 650M, and ProtT5 were comparatively small. Independent evaluation on 6,319 ChEMBL 37/BindingDB pairs revealed a substantial external domain shift, with mean absolute error increasing to approximately 0.94-0.95 despite chemically stringent internal validation. Nevertheless, receptor-specific information remained highly informative in a DRD2-DRD3 selectivity analysis: the cold-ligand ensemble achieved R2 = 0.853, Spearman{rho} = 0.916, and ROC-AUC = 0.966 for strong DRD3 selectivity, whereas the receptor-independent ablation approached chance-level discrimination. These results establish protein-language-model-conditioned molecular graph learning as a scalable strategy for GPCR bioactivity prediction while identifying chemotype novelty, external-domain transfer, and richer ligand-receptor interaction representations as key remaining challenges.
items.summary_zh: 提出融合配体分子图与GPCR蛋白语言模型表示的多模态图神经网络，同时预测定量pActivity和二元活性，并在多种化学与靶点划分下评估其泛化能力。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将受体序列信息显式纳入配体活性预测，对GPCR选择性建模有直接价值；但外部ChEMBL 37/BindingDB评估的误差升至约0.94–0.95，说明跨域迁移和新化学型仍是主要限制。
items.abstract_zh: 跨G蛋白偶联受体（GPCR）预测配体活性，需要模型同时捕获分子结构和受体特异性信息，并对化学域和靶点域偏移保持稳健。我们开发了一种多模态图神经网络，将显式配体分子图与GPCR序列的冻结蛋白语言模型表示相结合，并联合预测定量pActivity和二元活性。模型在271,739对经过整理的配体-GPCR样本上训练，涵盖183,694个配体和216个人GPCR，并采用随机、Bemis-Murcko骨架以及严格冷配体划分进行评估。使用ESM-2 650M受体嵌入时，所选模型在随机、冷配体和骨架评估下的平均绝对误差分别为0.513 {+/-} 0.006、0.540 {+/-} 0.006和0.641 {+/-} 0.005个pActivity单位，显著优于考虑蛋白信息的固定特征多层感知器，并且在定量预测上持续优于匹配的GINE基线。移除受体嵌入会显著降低回归和分类性能，而ESM-2 35M、ESM-2 650M和ProtT5之间的差异相对较小。在6,319对ChEMBL 37/BindingDB样本上的独立评估显示出显著的外部域偏移：尽管内部验证采用了严格的化学划分，平均绝对误差仍升至约0.94–0.95。不过，在DRD2-DRD3选择性分析中，受体特异性信息仍然非常有用：冷配体集成模型对强DRD3选择性的预测达到R2 = 0.853、Spearman{rho} = 0.916和ROC-AUC = 0.966，而不含受体信息的消融模型的判别能力接近随机水平。这些结果确立了蛋白语言模型条件化分子图学习作为GPCR生物活性预测的可扩展策略，同时指出化学型新颖性、外部域迁移以及更丰富的配体-受体相互作用表示仍是关键挑战。
items.author_line: De, M., Lodh, E., Majumder, S., Chowdhury, T.

items.title: Beyond the Ligand Applicability Domain: Generalization and Local Resolution in Structure-Aware Foundation Models for Affinity Prediction
items.abstract_or_text: Structure-aware foundation models that jointly represent proteins and ligands promise to extend affinity prediction beyond the chemical applicability domains of conventional ligand-based models, but whether they provide sufficient resolution to guide fine-grained medicinal-chemistry decisions remains unclear. We evaluatedBoltz-2across12kinasetargetsusinghistoricalbioactivityreconstruction,binding-pocket randomization, cross-target selectivity analysis, and chemical-series evaluation. Across chemically diverse compounds in temporally reconstructed evaluation sets, Boltz-2 and target-specific ligand-based machine learningshowedcomparablemeanglobalrankingacrosstargets,withsubstantialtarget-dependent differences (mean Kendall’s τ = 0.40 vs 0.31). Randomizing the binding pocket reduced mean τ from 0.33 to 0.14, while predictions were centered near −7.64 kcal/mol and retained correlated compound profiles acrossproteins.Together,theseresultssuggestastrongligand-conditionedsignal,withadditional predictive information contributed by the protein pocket. Despite this protein sensitivity, compound-level selectivitypredictionremainedweak(meanτ=0.17),andtheexperimentallystrongesttargetwas recovered for only 18.9% of compounds. Ranking also weakened within 72 temporally classified chemical series and varied substantially among series (protein-balanced mean τ = 0.18 for Boltz-2 and 0.09 for ligand-based models). These results show that structure-aware models can recover affinity information beyond relationshipscaptured by conventionalligand-based approaches whilerevealingaresolution boundary between broad prioritization and the local energetic discrimination required for selectivity and analogue ranking. At their current demonstrated resolution, such models appear best suited to broad compound or series prioritization and complementary hypothesis generation. Extending their use to fine analogueranking,selectivityoptimization,andinterpretationofsmallaffinitydifferenceswillrequire prospective evidence of reliable local resolution.
items.summary_zh: 系统评估Boltz-2在12个激酶靶点上的亲和力排序、结合口袋敏感性、选择性和化学系列内排序，界定结构感知基础模型从全局优先级到局部类似物决策的能力边界。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 对结构基础模型在药物化学中的实际分辨率给出较严格的诊断，避免将全局排序能力误作精细优化能力；研究为模型使用场景和前瞻性验证提出了明确要求。
items.abstract_zh: 结构感知基础模型联合表示蛋白质和配体，有望将亲和力预测扩展到传统配体模型的化学适用域之外，但它们是否具有指导精细药物化学决策所需的分辨率仍不清楚。我们在12个激酶靶点上评估了Boltz-2，采用历史生物活性重建、结合口袋随机化、跨靶点选择性分析和化学系列评估。在化学多样的时间重建评估集上，Boltz-2与靶点特异性配体机器学习模型在跨靶点的平均全局排序上表现相近，但靶点间存在显著差异（平均Kendall’s τ = 0.40 vs 0.31）。随机化结合口袋使平均τ从0.33降至0.14；预测值集中在约−7.64 kcal/mol附近，并且在不同蛋白质之间保留相关的化合物谱。总体而言，这些结果表明模型存在较强的配体条件信号，同时蛋白质口袋还能提供额外预测信息。尽管模型对蛋白质敏感，化合物层面的选择性预测仍然较弱（平均τ = 0.17），实验上最强的靶点仅对18.9%的化合物被正确找回。在72个按时间分类的化学系列中，排序能力也减弱，并且在系列之间变化很大（蛋白质平衡平均τ：Boltz-2为0.18，配体模型为0.09）。这些结果表明，结构感知模型能够恢复传统配体模型关系之外的亲和力信息，同时也揭示了其在广泛优先级排序与局部能量判别、选择性和类似物排序之间的分辨率边界。以目前展示的分辨率，这类模型更适合进行化合物或系列的广泛优先级排序以及辅助性假设生成。将其用于精细类似物排序、选择性优化和小幅亲和力差异解释，还需要可靠局部分辨率的前瞻性证据。
items.author_line: Pieter B. Burger, Thomas M. Kaiser, Parker Dryja, Morné Muller, MacLean Levin, Sandro Belvedere, Ilya Balabin, Yuri K. Peterson, Rian E. Pierneef, Fourie Joubert

items.title: Atom-JEPA: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture for 3D Atomistic Systems
items.abstract_or_text: Large-scale self-supervised pretraining has reshaped modern machine learning, substantially advancing the ability of language and vision models to generalize across downstream tasks. While deep learning has driven considerable progress in modeling atomistic systems in recent years, self-supervised pretraining in this domain has not yet achieved comparable downstream generalization. To address this, we introduce Atom-JEPA, a self-supervised pretraining framework that learns latent representations from unlabeled 3D structures through complementary atom-level and substructure-level objectives inspired by joint-embedding predictive architectures. We pretrain Atom-JEPA on large-scale molecular and crystalline datasets and evaluate its transfer performance by fine-tuning on a diverse set of downstream property prediction tasks. Atom-JEPA achieves state-of-the-art performance on molecular ADMET and quantum-chemical property prediction tasks, and is highly competitive in predicting the physical properties of crystalline materials. These results demonstrate the potential of latent-space predictive pretraining to support broad downstream generalization from structural data alone. Code and pretrained model checkpoints are publicly available at https://github.com/khelverskovp/atom-jepa
items.summary_zh: 提出Atom-JEPA，自监督学习框架在无标注三维分子和晶体结构上进行原子级与子结构级联合嵌入预测预训练，并迁移到ADMET、量子化学和晶体物性任务。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 尝试把JEPA式潜空间预测引入原子体系，覆盖分子和晶体两类数据并提供代码与预训练权重；但摘要主要报告基准性能，尚未给出具体数据集规模和逐任务提升幅度。
items.abstract_zh: 大规模自监督预训练已经重塑现代机器学习，显著提升了语言和视觉模型在下游任务上的泛化能力。近年来深度学习推动了原子体系建模的显著进展，但该领域的自监督预训练尚未实现同等程度的下游泛化。为此，我们提出Atom-JEPA，一种受联合嵌入预测架构启发的自监督预训练框架，通过互补的原子级和子结构级目标，从无标注三维结构中学习潜在表示。我们在大规模分子和晶体数据集上预训练Atom-JEPA，并通过在多种下游性质预测任务上微调来评估其迁移性能。Atom-JEPA在分子ADMET和量子化学性质预测任务上达到当前最优性能，并在晶体材料物理性质预测方面具有很强的竞争力。这些结果展示了仅凭结构数据进行潜空间预测式预训练、从而支持广泛下游泛化的潜力。代码和预训练模型检查点已公开于https://github.com/khelverskovp/atom-jepa
items.author_line: Kasper Helverskov Petersen, Rasmus Hannibal Tirsgaard, François R J Cornet, Mikkel Jordahn, Mikkel N. Schmidt

items.title: Mathematical Invariant-Enabled Topological Neural Networks for Molecular and Materials Property Prediction
items.abstract_or_text: Existing molecular and materials learning approaches often rely on a limited set of structural representations, which may capture only selected aspects of complex three-dimensional structure. Here, we introduce mathematical invariant-enabled topological neural networks (MITNNs), a framework that represents complex structures through multiple complementary mathematical views and integrates them with topological neural architectures. MITNNs combine multiscale invariants from topology, spectral theory, commutative algebra, differential geometry, and discrete curvature, capturing complementary structural information from the same system. Systematic invariant-subset, architecture-subset, and ensemble analyses show that predictive performance depends on how mathematical representations and neural architectures are paired, with selected combinations outperforming individual models and the aggregation of all available components. Across protein-ligand binding, metal-organic framework properties, mutation-induced protein solubility, and molecular toxicity prediction, MITNN consistently outperforms existing methods. These results establish MITNN as a mathematically multimodal framework for scientific machine learning.
items.summary_zh: 构建数学不变量增强的拓扑神经网络MITNN，将拓扑、谱理论、交换代数、微分几何和离散曲率等多尺度表示与拓扑架构组合，用于多类分子与材料性质预测。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 通过系统的表示子集、架构子集和集成分析说明多种数学视角的互补性，并覆盖结合、MOF、蛋白溶解度和毒性任务；但摘要未报告具体数据集与统计显著性。
items.abstract_zh: 现有分子和材料学习方法通常依赖有限的结构表示，可能只能捕获复杂三维结构的某些方面。在此，我们提出数学不变量增强的拓扑神经网络（MITNN），一种通过多个互补数学视角表示复杂结构、并将其与拓扑神经架构整合的框架。MITNN结合来自拓扑学、谱理论、交换代数、微分几何和离散曲率的多尺度不变量，从同一体系中捕获互补的结构信息。系统的不变量子集、架构子集和集成分析表明，预测性能取决于数学表示与神经架构的配对方式；经过选择的组合优于单个模型以及对所有可用组件的简单聚合。在蛋白质-配体结合、金属有机框架性质、突变诱导的蛋白质溶解度和分子毒性预测任务中，MITNN均持续优于现有方法。这些结果确立了MITNN作为科学机器学习的数学多模态框架。
items.author_line: Yiming Ren, Xiang Liu, Mustafa Hajij, Pietro Liò, Guo-Wei Wei

items.title: From Benchmark to Bench: Can Agents Survive Real-World Drug Discovery?
items.abstract_or_text: Agentic systems increasingly coordinate molecular-design tools, but it is unclear which layer of the stack limits outcomes on real projects. We developed MAGI, an open modular agent that authors objectives, launches and monitors optimization, interprets structure--activity relationships, and revises its strategy accordingly. MAGI generates molecules either directly through the LLM or by delegating to REINVENT 4, with scoring services interchangeable behind a common contract. We tested it across nine retrospective lead-optimization campaigns from three pharmaceutical companies, replayed under fixed temporal cutoffs. Both routes produced valid structures: LLM proposals stayed closer to local chemistry and reached comparable or higher primary activity in fewer operations, whereas REINVENT explored broader chemical space. Whether a campaign met its objective depended on the predictive models, not on the generation route: attainment followed model accuracy on the chemistry proposed, dropping once that chemistry moved outside the model's applicability domain. Separately, a blinded evaluation asked whether the MAGI's output could pass as expert work: chemists were not able to discriminate agentic proposals from held-out compounds, and judged the SAR reasoning broadly plausible yet incomplete. Together, these results position MAGI as a coordination layer pluggable into existing computational chemistry workflows. The ceiling on real projects, however, remains currently set by scorer applicability rather than by tool orchestration.
items.summary_zh: 开发开放模块化药物设计智能体MAGI，能够制定目标、监控优化、解读SAR并调整策略；在三家药企的九个回顾性先导优化项目中比较LLM直接生成与REINVENT 4委托生成。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把智能体放到真实历史药物发现流程中评估，并发现预测模型适用域而非分子生成路线决定项目上限；局限是回顾性重放尚未证明前瞻性实验成功。
items.abstract_zh: 智能体系统越来越多地协调分子设计工具，但在真实项目中究竟是哪一层限制了结果仍不清楚。我们开发了MAGI，一种开放的模块化智能体，能够制定目标、启动并监控优化、解释构效关系，并据此修订策略。MAGI既可以直接通过LLM生成分子，也可以将生成委托给REINVENT 4，评分服务则可通过通用契约进行替换。我们在三家制药公司的九个回顾性先导优化项目上进行了测试，并在固定时间截点下重放。两种路线都产生了有效结构：LLM提案更接近局部化学，并以更少的操作达到相当或更高的主要活性，而REINVENT探索了更广的化学空间。一个项目能否达到目标取决于预测模型，而不是生成路线：当所提出的化学结构超出模型适用域时，目标达成率会随着模型在该化学空间上的准确性下降而降低。另一项盲法评估询问MAGI的输出能否被视为专家工作：化学家无法将智能体提案与留出的化合物区分开，并认为其SAR推理总体合理但不完整。总体而言，这些结果将MAGI定位为可插入现有计算化学流程的协调层。然而，真实项目的上限目前仍由评分器适用域决定，而不是工具编排。
items.author_line: Pierre Llompart, Levent Guner, Helen Lai, Alessandro Tibo, Yijie Xu

items.title: Surface-Aware Generative Design of Selective Inhibitors for Protein–Membrane Adsorption
items.abstract_or_text: Peripheral membrane proteins (PMPs) bind membrane surfaces through interfacial binding sites (IBSs) that are critical for stable membrane association and proper orientation of catalytic active sites. Dysregulated PMP–membrane interactions can enhance catalytic activity and contribute to diseases including cancer, but many PMPs remain difficult therapeutic targets because their active sites lack well-defined pockets or become accessible only upon membrane binding. In this work, we developed a multistage computational framework that integrates MaSIF-PMP, a surface-centered geometric deep learning model for IBS prediction, with a generative diffusion model to design protein binders that target PMP IBSs and inhibit membrane adsorption. Candidate binders were ranked using MaSIF-PMP prediction scores and geometric descriptors, then validated by molecular dynamics and enhanced sampling simulations. Applied to three disease-relevant PMPs, the framework identified selective binders that disrupted membrane association while minimizing off-target membrane interactions, providing a potential strategy for designing PMP membrane-adsorption inhibitors.
items.summary_zh: 提出面向蛋白质-膜吸附界面的多阶段生成设计流程，以MaSIF-PMP预测界面结合位点，再用扩散模型设计抑制膜吸附的蛋白结合体，并通过分子动力学和增强采样验证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 针对传统口袋缺失或仅在膜结合时暴露的外周膜蛋白，提供了新的界面靶向策略；但证据主要来自计算模拟，尚无实验结合或功能验证。
items.abstract_zh: 外周膜蛋白（PMPs）通过界面结合位点（IBSs）结合膜表面，这些位点对于稳定的膜结合以及催化活性位点的正确取向至关重要。失调的PMP–膜相互作用可增强催化活性，并促成包括癌症在内的疾病，但许多PMP仍是难以成药的靶点，因为其活性位点缺乏明确口袋，或只有在结合膜后才会暴露。在本研究中，我们开发了一个多阶段计算框架，将用于IBS预测的以表面为中心的几何深度学习模型MaSIF-PMP与生成式扩散模型相结合，设计靶向PMP IBS并抑制膜吸附的蛋白结合体。候选结合体根据MaSIF-PMP预测分数和几何描述符进行排序，然后通过分子动力学和增强采样模拟验证。将该框架应用于三个与疾病相关的PMP后，模型识别出能够破坏膜结合、同时尽量减少脱靶膜相互作用的选择性结合体，为设计PMP膜吸附抑制剂提供了潜在策略。
items.author_line: ByungUk Park, Reid C. Van Lehn

items.title: Flock: A Negative-Enriched Protein-Protein Interaction Dataset
items.abstract_or_text: Protein-protein interactions (PPIs) govern fundamental biological processes and are central to therapeutic discovery, yet computational prediction methods remain severely limited by a lack of high-quality negative data (non-interacting PPIs). Existing models are trained almost exclusively on positive interactions or random pairs designated as negatives, while legacy negative datasets are limited in scale and contain correctness errors. To address this, we introduce Flock, a negative-enriched PPI dataset of unprecedented scale, containing 26,934 positive and 377,643 negative pairs. Flock integrates biological assemblies from the PDB with highly confident, curated negatives mined from scientific literature using a state-of-the-art agentic LLM workflow. To address the evaluation leakage seen in protein structure modelling, we also present Flock's Leakage-Free Set, a benchmark that strictly controls for sequence and interface similarity, and historical date-based cutoffs used in the training of co-folding models. Our evaluation reveals that the co-folding model ESMFold2 shows performance degradation on the Leakage-Free set, whereas the protein language model ESMC demonstrates stronger generalisation. Flock provides the most comprehensive and challenging PPI benchmark to date, establishing a rigorous new standard for evaluating the generalisability of protein structure and language models on this task.
items.summary_zh: 发布含有26,934个正相互作用和377,643个负相互作用的PPI数据集Flock，并构建控制序列、界面相似性和时间泄漏的Leakage-Free Set，评估ESMFold2与ESMC的泛化。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 系统补足PPI预测中长期缺乏高质量负样本的问题，并把时间截断和结构相似性泄漏纳入评测；负样本由文献和智能体流程整理，仍需独立实验验证其真实性。
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPIs）支配基本生物过程，也是治疗发现的核心，但计算预测方法仍受到高质量负数据（不相互作用的PPI）缺乏的严重限制。现有模型几乎全部在正相互作用上训练，或将随机配对指定为负样本；传统负数据集规模有限且存在正确性错误。为此，我们提出Flock，一个规模前所未有的富含负样本的PPI数据集，包含26,934个正相互作用对和377,643个负相互作用对。Flock整合了PDB中的生物学组装体，以及通过最先进的智能体LLM流程从科学文献中挖掘并整理的高置信度负样本。为解决蛋白质结构建模中的评估泄漏问题，我们还提出Leakage-Free Set，严格控制序列和界面相似性，并采用按历史日期截断的训练数据，以匹配协同折叠模型的训练时间范围。评估显示，协同折叠模型ESMFold2在Leakage-Free Set上的性能下降，而蛋白质语言模型ESMC表现出更强的泛化能力。Flock提供了目前最全面、最具挑战性的PPI基准，确立了评估蛋白质结构模型和语言模型在该任务上泛化能力的新标准。
items.author_line: Kashif-Khan, N., Gregory, H., Potterton, A. G.

items.title: RGI-Toolkit: Differentiable Restraints for Controllable Biomolecular Structure Prediction
items.abstract_or_text: Diffusion-based models have substantially advanced biomolecular structure prediction. Within this framework, restraint-guided inference (RGI) corrects the denoiser output at each reverse-diffusion step using a differentiable restraint loss, allowing available experimental information, stereochemical requirements, or a specified target conformational state to be incorporated into predictions without retraining the model. Here, we present RGI-Toolkit, a general-purpose Python library that makes RGI available for a range of structure predictors. The toolkit consolidates restraint definition, atom selection, loss evaluation, and coordinate optimization into a shared, backend-agnostic engine, limiting predictor-specific code to a thin preprocessing adapter and a single hook in the denoising loop. Restraints on distances, angles, and dihedrals, on deviations from reference structures, and on user-defined reaction coordinates, together with ligand conformer restraints, are all specified in a common configuration format. The toolkit currently supports six predictors, including AlphaFold3. Across all six predictors, conformer restraints eliminated chirality and cis/trans errors in the predicted ligands and improved their local geometry, while geometric and custom restraints systematically shifted the sampled protein conformations toward the specified target states. RGI-Toolkit thus provides a unified framework for integrating experimental information and prior geometric knowledge into structure prediction and for generating biomolecular structures with specified conformational and stereochemical properties.
items.summary_zh: 提供后端无关的RGI-Toolkit，将距离、角度、二面角、参考结构偏差、反应坐标和配体构象等可微约束接入六种扩散式结构预测器，包括AlphaFold3。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把实验信息和几何先验直接融入反向扩散而无需重新训练，可用于可控构象与立体化学生成；但摘要未说明约束效果是否在真实实验结构上验证。
items.abstract_zh: 基于扩散的模型显著推动了生物分子结构预测。在该框架中，约束引导推断（RGI）在每个反向扩散步骤使用可微约束损失校正去噪器输出，使可用的实验信息、立体化学要求或指定的目标构象状态能够在不重新训练模型的情况下纳入预测。在此，我们提出RGI-Toolkit，一个面向多种结构预测器的通用Python库。该工具包将约束定义、原子选择、损失评估和坐标优化整合到共享的后端无关引擎中，使预测器特定代码仅限于一个薄的预处理适配器和去噪循环中的单个钩子。距离、角度和二面角约束、相对于参考结构的偏差约束、用户定义的反应坐标约束，以及配体构象约束，都可以使用统一配置格式指定。RGI-Toolkit目前支持六种预测器，包括AlphaFold3。在全部六种预测器上，构象约束消除了预测配体中的手性和顺反错误并改善其局部几何，而几何约束和自定义约束则系统地将采样到的蛋白质构象推向指定目标状态。因此，RGI-Toolkit为将实验信息和先验几何知识整合进结构预测，以及生成具有指定构象和立体化学性质的生物分子结构，提供了统一框架。
items.author_line: Hori, T., Moriwaki, Y., Ishitani, R.

items.title: Data-Driven Discovery of Boronic Acid Catalysts for Amidation Reactions
items.abstract_or_text: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly recognized as a powerful tool for catalyst optimization in organic synthesis. Yet, applications are often restricted by the need for large datasets, programming expertise, and specialized knowledge in model development. Boronic acidcatalyzed amidation reactions represent an attractive target for AI-guided optimization because of their synthetic relevance, detailed mechanistic understanding, and the need for improved catalysts for amidations. Here, an AI-guided workflow for catalyst optimization in boronic acidcatalyzed amidation reactions was established using the large-language model ChatGPT for code generation and workflow development. A dataset was generated by high-throughput screening of 459 arylboronic acids and combined with DFT-derived steric and electronic descriptors of the catalysts for model training. The model enabled the identification of the unprecedented catalyst FIBA with higher activity than the benchmark catalyst MIBA. In addition, detailed data analysis of the highly active but poorly predicted diboronic acid catalyst DBA led to the identification of a distinct activation mode involving higher-order boronate aggregates that activate and preorganize the amine nucleophile. Thus, improved catalyst performance and new mechanistic insight were obtained through an AI-guided workflow.
items.summary_zh: 利用459种芳基硼酸的高通量筛选数据和DFT立体/电子描述符，建立AI辅助硼酸催化酰胺化优化流程，发现活性高于MIBA的新催化剂FIBA，并提出DBA高阶硼酸酯聚集体的活化机制。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 同时展示了前瞻性催化剂发现和机制线索，且把ChatGPT用于代码与流程开发；但摘要未给出实验重复、反应范围和模型外推边界。
items.abstract_zh: 人工智能正日益被视为有力的催化剂优化工具。然而，相关应用常常受限于大规模数据集、编程技能以及模型开发专门知识的需求。硼酸催化的酰胺化反应具有合成相关性高、机理认识较充分以及需要改进酰胺化催化剂等特点，是AI引导优化的有吸引力目标。在此，我们利用大语言模型ChatGPT进行代码生成和工作流开发，建立了硼酸催化酰胺化反应的AI引导催化剂优化流程。我们通过459种芳基硼酸的高通量筛选生成数据集，并结合催化剂的DFT立体和电子描述符进行模型训练。该模型发现了此前未报道的催化剂FIBA，其活性高于基准催化剂MIBA。此外，对活性很高但预测效果较差的二硼酸催化剂DBA进行详细数据分析后，我们发现了一种不同的活化模式：高阶硼酸酯聚集体能够活化并预组织胺亲核体。因此，该AI引导流程同时带来了更高的催化剂性能和新的机理认识。
items.author_line: Hanna Weller, Tobias Schnitzer

items.title: Data-Driven Prospective Design of Phase-Inversion Conductive Polymer Membranes
items.abstract_or_text: Conductive polymer membranes combine separation and electrical functionality, but their design remains challenging because performance emerges from coupled effects of composition, fabrication, and operating conditions. Here, we assembled 396 membrane records from 77 publications and developed target-specific machine-learning models for pure-water permeability (PWP), solute rejection, and electrical conductivity. Weighted artificial neural network ensembles for PWP and rejection and XGBoost for conductivity achieved fixed-holdout R2 values of 0.855, 0.896, and 0.914, respectively, with distinct SHAP feature-contribution patterns across the three targets. We then coupled the predictive models with residual Gaussian-process uncertainty estimation and sequential Monte Carlo expected hypervolume improvement to search a 3,024-member PANI–DBSA/PES design space and identify 12 formulations for prospective experimental evaluation. Atomistic molecular dynamics simulations provided complementary mechanistic insight: increasing PANI from 0.47 to 1.89 wt% decreased the first-shell hydration number around DBSA sulfonate sites from 1.02 to 0.74, while the apparent finite-time water diffusion coefficient declined from 0.6910-10 m2∙s-1 in neat PES to 0.3710-10 m2∙s-1 at 1.89 wt% PANI. Together, these results connect literature-derived learning, uncertainty-aware formulation selection, and molecular-scale interpretation, providing a systematic framework for prospective conductive membrane design
items.summary_zh: 汇总396条膜记录，建立针对纯水渗透率、溶质截留率和电导率的机器学习模型，并结合高斯过程不确定性和序贯蒙特卡洛提出12种导电聚合物膜配方进行前瞻性实验。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将文献数据、基于不确定性的配方搜索、分子动力学机理解释和前瞻性实验连接起来；但数据集来自77篇文献，跨文献工艺差异可能影响模型可迁移性。
items.abstract_zh: 导电聚合物膜兼具分离和电学功能，但其设计仍然困难，因为性能由组成、制备和操作条件的耦合效应共同决定。在此，我们汇总了来自77篇出版物的396条膜记录，并针对纯水渗透率（PWP）、溶质截留率和电导率建立了特定目标的机器学习模型。PWP和截留率采用加权人工神经网络集成模型，电导率采用XGBoost；在固定留出集上，三者的R2分别达到0.855、0.896和0.914，并且三个目标呈现不同的SHAP特征贡献模式。随后，我们将预测模型与残差高斯过程不确定性估计以及序贯蒙特卡洛期望超体积改进相结合，在包含3,024种成员的PANI–DBSA/PES设计空间中搜索，并确定12种配方进行前瞻性实验评估。原子级分子动力学模拟提供了互补的机理信息：将PANI从0.47增加到1.89 wt%后，DBSA磺酸位点周围第一水合壳层的水合数从1.02降至0.74，而表观有限时间水扩散系数则从纯PES中的0.6910-10 m2?s-1降至PANI为1.89 wt%时的0.3710-10 m2?s-1。总体而言，该工作将基于文献的学习、不确定性感知的配方选择与分子尺度解释连接起来，为前瞻性导电膜设计提供了系统框架。
items.author_line: Jinyu Liu, Jiayue Hu, Zefang Huang, Bingxin Li, Ling Liu, Heyang Yuan

items.title: Accelerating discovery of phosphorescent blue OLED emitters using chemical foundation models
items.abstract_or_text: In OLED displays, phosphorescent emitter molecules are used for red and green but not for blue pixels. Iridium organometallics are promising phosphorescent emitters, but a molecule satisfying the requirements of color, brightness, and stability has not yet been developed. One strategy to discover an emitter is virtual screening, in which computational predictions are used to prioritize candidates for synthesis. Due to the computational difficulty of screening with first-principles methods such as density functional theory (DFT), empirical machine-learning methods have been used for virtual screening. Recently, machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) have provided fast proxies for DFT energies. This suggests that virtual screening could be conducted with ML proxies for DFT calculations rather than empirical ML, but this has not yet been applied to OLEDs. We show on a dataset of experimental values extracted from the literature that for emission wavelength, MLIP-based predictions are not inferior to empirical ML. Using an MLIP, we screened millions of molecules for blue emission. Although blue emission is not sufficient for an emitter, our results suggest that further development of virtual screening could focus on machine learned proxies for DFT prediction pipelines rather than models trained to experimental data.
items.summary_zh: 使用机器学习原子间势作为DFT能量代理，在文献实验数据上评估发光波长预测，并对数百万分子进行蓝光磷光OLED发射体虚拟筛选。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把MLIP代理用于高成本OLED筛选，展示了从实验数据预测到大规模候选搜索的路径；但蓝光发射只是必要条件，摘要没有报告合成或器件性能验证。
items.abstract_zh: 在OLED显示器中，磷光发射体分子已用于红色和绿色像素，但尚未用于蓝色像素。铱有机金属化合物是有前景的磷光发射体，但尚未开发出同时满足颜色、亮度和稳定性要求的分子。发现发射体的一种策略是虚拟筛选，即利用计算预测为合成候选物排序。由于使用密度泛函理论（DFT）等第一性原理方法进行筛选的计算难度很高，研究者采用经验机器学习方法进行虚拟筛选。近年来，机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）提供了DFT能量的快速代理。这表明，可以使用ML代理替代基于实验数据训练的经验ML来开展OLED虚拟筛选，但这种方法尚未应用于OLED。在一组从文献中提取的实验值数据集上，我们表明，对于发射波长，基于MLIP的预测不劣于经验ML。利用MLIP，我们对数百万个分子进行了蓝光发射筛选。尽管蓝光发射并不足以成为发射体，但我们的结果表明，虚拟筛选的进一步发展可以聚焦于使用机器学习的DFT预测流程代理，而不是训练于实验数据的模型。
items.author_line: Alexander Davis, Ihor Neporozhnii, Félix Therrien, Suhas Mahesh, Zhibo Wang, Ze-Lin Zhu, Jeffrey Cheung, Oleksandra Ostapenko, Alex Zhuang, Xiang Chen, Arik Mitschang, Edward Hunter, Brandon Sutherland, Sjoerd Hoogland, Edward Sargent, Eli Zysman-Colman, Oleksandr Voznyy

items.title: Water-Soluble Isocyanides for Passerini-Mediated Peptide Modification and Ligation
items.abstract_or_text: Protein solubility is a key factor of peptide and protein modification and downstream application, yet chemical functionalization under aqueous conditions often compromise solubility. Here, we introduce a new class of ionic, water-soluble isocyanides for the functionalization of peptide carboxyl groups under aqueous conditions. By combining strong hydrogen-bonding motifs with ionic functionalities, these reagents provide enhanced water solubility while enabling modulation of peptide isoelectric points. The isocyanides were synthesized via a concise route and applied successfully in Passerini multicomponent reactions without observable precipitation. The resulting esterified peptides remained water-soluble even for highly hydrophobic sequences. They also served as competent substrates for omniligase-1-mediated ligation, with polar cationic modifications showing particularly favorable performance. These results demonstrate that rational isocyanide design can overcome solubility losses associated with peptide esterification, expand the scope of isocyanide-based ligation chemistry in aqueous environments, and provide a platform for tuning protein surface charge.
items.summary_zh: 设计离子型水溶性异氰化物，在水相Passerini多组分反应中修饰肽羧基并进行连接，使高疏水序列的酯化肽保持可溶，并测试其Omniligase-1连接性能。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 解决水相肽修饰中溶解度损失这一实际瓶颈，兼顾试剂设计、反应适用性与酶促连接；仍需更多底物范围和生物功能验证。
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质溶解度是肽和蛋白质修饰及其下游应用的关键因素，但在水相条件下进行化学官能化往往会损害溶解度。在此，我们引入一类离子型水溶性异氰化物，用于在水相条件下官能化肽的羧基。通过结合强氢键基团与离子官能团，这些试剂在提高水溶性的同时，还能调节肽的等电点。这些异氰化物通过简洁路线合成，并成功用于Passerini多组分反应，未观察到沉淀。所得酯化肽即使对于高度疏水的序列仍保持水溶性。它们也可作为Omniligase-1介导连接反应的有效底物，其中极性阳离子修饰表现出尤其良好的性能。这些结果表明，合理设计异氰化物能够克服肽酯化相关的溶解度损失，扩展水相异氰化物连接化学的范围，并为调节蛋白质表面电荷提供平台。
items.author_line: M. Lambers, J. Hanssens, T.A.A. Combaret, G. Bartkiewicz, L. J. van den Bos, J. M. Saya

items.title: OxiGen: Oxidation-State-Aware Crystal Generation
items.abstract_or_text: Generative models have the potential to accelerate inorganic materials discovery by enabling inverse design, but generating experimentally realisable crystals remains challenging. Oxidation states are widely used to assess the compositional validity of crystals and guide inorganic materials discovery. While existing generative models for crystals can generate materials with charge-neutral oxidation-state assignments, they poorly reproduce the distributions of oxidation states observed in synthesised materials. To address this limitation, we propose OxiGen, an oxidation-state-aware crystal diffusion model that explicitly represents oxidation states during generation. OxiGen enforces global charge neutrality by construction using a structured output layer with exact inference over a finite-state automaton. Empirically, OxiGen substantially improves oxidation-state fidelity, generates the highest rate of stable, unique, and novel crystals among evaluated methods, and maintains high compositional validity even under property conditioning.
items.summary_zh: 提出显式表示氧化态的晶体扩散模型OxiGen，通过有限状态自动机精确推断强制全局电荷中性，提高生成晶体的氧化态保真度、稳定性、唯一性和新颖性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把氧化态分布这一无机材料生成中的化学约束直接纳入生成过程，兼顾电荷守恒和性质条件生成；仍需实验合成验证可实现性。
items.abstract_zh: 生成模型有望通过逆向设计加速无机材料发现，但生成实验上可实现的晶体仍然具有挑战性。氧化态被广泛用于评估晶体的组成有效性，并指导无机材料发现。现有晶体生成模型能够生成具有电荷中性氧化态分配的材料，但难以复现实验合成材料中观察到的氧化态分布。为解决这一限制，我们提出OxiGen，一种具有氧化态感知能力的晶体扩散模型，在生成过程中显式表示氧化态。OxiGen使用带有有限状态自动机精确推断的结构化输出层，从构造上强制全局电荷中性。在实证评估中，OxiGen显著提高了氧化态保真度，在所比较的方法中生成了最高比例的稳定、唯一和新颖晶体，并且即使在性质条件控制下仍保持很高的组成有效性。
items.author_line: Dylan John, Kim E. Jelfs, Alex M. Ganose, Eleonora Giunchiglia

items.title: Neural Petri flows for chemical reactions
items.abstract_or_text: Petri nets have been used to describe chemical processes such as reactions.They map well to chemistry: Places are the bonds between atoms and the free valence of each atom, a token is a unit of bond order, a transition forms or breaks a bond, the conserved quantities are the valence budgets of the atoms, and the enabling rule is the valence rule. These semantics are not guaranteed by learned models of reactions or neural networks that are built on Petri nets that use the net as a scaffold for message passing. Here, we ask what architecture remains a Petri net for every value of its weights. We find the answer in the theory, where all semantics of a net share the firing form m^\prime=m+Cσ, locality, as enabling reads only the inputs of a transition, and the enabling rule, and we prove that conservation forces the firing form and that non-negativity forces the enabling rule on local rate laws. This leaves free the rate law, which is the propensity of each transition to fire. We introduce Neural Petri Flow, which learns this rate law, or a readout for classification, and hard-wires the rest as parameter-free layers. On what we denote a valence net, atom mapping, reaction classification, and forward prediction become three tasks on one firing vector. Without training, the minimum firing vector maps 88.8% of the curated Golden set against 85.6% for RXNMapper, and 88.7 against 77.9% of the enzymatic reactions of EnzymeMap. On USPTO-480K, NPF trained on these firing vectors predicts 87.7% of the products and 67.4% when trained on a 1% subset of the training reactions. EC numbers of ECREACT are predicted at the third level for 90.2% of reactions, 5.6 points ahead of the best published method. With electrons as tokens, the same token game predicts 90.5% of the elementary steps of FlowER first, ahead of the published baseline, and every top-1 prediction is a valid molecule without a filter.
items.summary_zh: 将化学反应表示为具有价态守恒语义的Petri网，并提出仅学习转移速率律的Neural Petri Flow，在原子映射、反应分类、产物预测和酶反应任务上统一建模。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把价态、非负性和守恒等化学语义硬编码进网络，减少无效分子输出并提升小数据学习；摘要主要是基准评估，尚未显示复杂真实反应的实验闭环。
items.abstract_zh: Petri网一直被用于描述化学过程，例如化学反应。它们与化学高度匹配：Place表示原子之间的键和每个原子的自由价，token是键级单位，transition形成或断裂一条键，守恒量是原子的价预算，而使能规则是价态规则。然而，学习得到的反应模型，或把Petri网作为消息传递骨架的神经网络，并不保证这些语义。这里我们询问：对于权重的任意取值，什么样的架构仍然是一个Petri网？我们在相关理论中找到了答案：网络的所有语义都具有发射形式m^\prime=m+C��，具有局部性（因为使能读取的只是某个transition的输入），并具有使能规则；我们证明，守恒性迫使其采用发射形式，而非负性迫使局部速率律遵守使能规则。这样，唯一可学习的部分就是速率律，即每个transition发生的倾向。我们提出Neural Petri Flow，学习该速率律，或学习用于分类的读出，同时将其余部分作为无参数层硬编码。在我们称为价态网的网络上，原子映射、反应分类和正向预测成为同一发射向量上的三个任务。在不训练的情况下，最小发射向量在整理后的Golden数据集上实现88.8%的映射率，而RXNMapper为85.6%；在EnzymeMap的酶反应上为88.7%，而RXNMapper为77.9%。在USPTO-480K上，使用这些发射向量训练的NPF能够预测87.7%的产物；仅使用1%的训练反应子集训练时，仍能预测67.4%的产物。ECREACT的EC编号在第三级分类上达到90.2%的准确率，比发表的最佳方法高5.6个百分点。将电子作为token后，同一token游戏能够预测FlowER的90.5%基元步骤，高于已发表基线，并且每个top-1预测都是无需过滤即可成立的有效分子。
items.author_line: Jose Eduardo Escrig Molina, Daniel Probst

items.title: CausalBind: Causal Modeling and Learning for Protein-Molecule Virtual Screening
items.abstract_or_text: Protein-molecule virtual screening is increasingly cast as a problem of representation learning in a shared embedding space. Existing methods rely on dense holistic alignment, entangling invariant binding determinants with nuisance correlations and limiting transfer to new targets. It has been noted that binding in protein-molecule systems involves sparse cross-modality interactions: binding is governed by a small contact interface and a few decisive local interactions (e.g., hydrogen bonds, hydrophobic contacts, and salt bridges) rather than the global structures of the protein and molecule. We hypothesize that uncovering and leveraging sparse interaction patterns is critical for generalization beyond the training data, as these patterns are reusable and expected to improve performance across different scenarios. In this paper, we aim to identify and leverage sparse interaction patterns, and verify our hypothesis. Since the training data contain only observed binding pairs, we formalize this prior via a V-structure causal model under Heckman-style selection, and establish three theoretical results: (i) the latent concepts of interacting proteins and molecules are not identifiable without appropriate sparsity constraints; (ii) these concepts and their sparse interactions are component-wise identifiable under structural sparsity conditions; and (iii) a low-rank relaxation of these conditions yields subspace identifiability of the concepts and interactions. Inspired by these principles, we propose CausalBind with three implementation variants. Extensive experiments on DUD-E and LIT-PCBA benchmarks show that all variants consistently outperform strong retrieval baselines, with the largest gains on LIT-PCBA early enrichment, and further generalize to target- and scaffold-level out-of-distribution splits. Code is available at https://github.com/lokali/CausalBind.
items.summary_zh: 以稀疏蛋白质-分子接触为因果先验，提出CausalBind及其三个实现变体，在DUD-E和LIT-PCBA上进行虚拟筛选，并测试靶点级和骨架级分布外泛化。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将选择偏差、可识别性和稀疏局部相互作用纳入虚拟筛选理论与模型设计，在LIT-PCBA早期富集和分布外划分上显示优势；仍需前瞻性结合实验确认。
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质-分子虚拟筛选越来越多地被表述为共享嵌入空间中的表示学习问题。现有方法依赖稠密的整体对齐，将不变的结合决定因素与干扰相关性纠缠在一起，从而限制了向新靶点的迁移。已有研究指出，蛋白质-分子体系中的结合涉及稀疏的跨模态相互作用：结合由一个较小的接触界面和少数决定性局部相互作用（例如氢键、疏水接触和盐桥）控制，而不是由蛋白质和分子的整体结构控制。我们假设，发现并利用稀疏相互作用模式对于超越训练数据的泛化至关重要，因为这些模式具有可复用性，并有望在不同情景下改善性能。在本文中，我们旨在识别并利用稀疏相互作用模式，并验证这一假设。由于训练数据只包含观察到的结合配对，我们在Heckman式选择框架下，通过V形结构因果模型形式化这一先验，并建立三个理论结果：（i）没有适当的稀疏性约束时，相互作用蛋白质和分子的潜在概念不可识别；（ii）在结构稀疏条件下，这些概念及其稀疏相互作用可以按分量识别；（iii）这些条件的低秩松弛给出概念和相互作用的子空间可识别性。受这些原则启发，我们提出CausalBind的三个实现变体。在DUD-E和LIT-PCBA基准上的大量实验显示，所有变体都持续优于强检索基线，在LIT-PCBA早期富集上的提升最大，并且在靶点级和骨架级分布外划分上进一步实现泛化。代码可在https://github.com/lokali/CausalBind获取。

items.title: A self-learning scientific agent for X-ray diffraction
items.abstract_or_text: A central challenge for scientific agents is to turn analytical experience into reusable expertise grounded in physical evidence. Here we introduce Gan Jiang, a self-learning agent for powder X-ray diffraction built on a diffraction-analysis ecosystem we developed: XMatcher, XQueryer, XDecomposer and WPEM. Together, these engines span phase identification, multiphase decomposition and physics-constrained whole-pattern modelling. Gan Jiang converts analytical experience into executable skills by diagnosing failures, revising skill instructions and code, and validating revisions before reuse, without retraining the language model or changing the underlying physical models. Skills selected using development data and frozen before held-out evaluation achieve higher refinement scores than the original expert-designed skills across FullProf, GSAS-II and PyWPEM. The agent resolves strongly overlapping reflections, quantifies a five-phase ancient Egyptian cosmetic, tracks lattice evolution in an operating battery and compares atomic configurations in a disordered oxide catalyst. On DeltaXRDbench, it leads the evaluated methods in single- and multiphase identification across simulated and experimental data. Without supplied composition, single-phase top-1 accuracies reach 96.30\%, 81.78\% and 40.83\% on MP500, RRUFF and opXRD, respectively, compared with 58.00\%, 58.47\% and 26.45\% for the strongest comparator. These results demonstrate how an integrated scientific tool ecosystem can support agents that extract structural knowledge from measurements while accumulating validated analytical expertise that transfers to new samples.
items.summary_zh: 构建自学习粉末X射线衍射智能体Gan Jiang，结合相识别、多相分解和物理约束全谱建模，并通过验证后的技能修订提升多种软件和数据集上的分析性能。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把物理分析工具、失败诊断和可验证技能积累结合起来，在模拟与实验数据以及古代化妆品、电池和催化剂案例中展示跨样品迁移；仍需更广泛的独立实验室评估。
items.abstract_zh: 科学智能体面临的一个核心挑战，是将分析经验转化为基于物理证据、可重复使用的专业能力。在此，我们介绍Gan Jiang，一个用于粉末X射线衍射的自学习智能体，它建立在我们开发的衍射分析生态系统之上：XMatcher、XQueryer、XDecomposer和WPEM。这些引擎共同覆盖物相识别、多相分解和受物理约束的全谱建模。Gan Jiang通过诊断失败、修订技能说明和代码，并在再次使用前验证修订结果，将分析经验转化为可执行技能；这一过程无需重新训练语言模型，也不改变底层物理模型。使用开发数据选择并在留出评估前冻结的技能，在FullProf、GSAS-II和PyWPEM上取得了高于原始专家设计技能的精修分数。该智能体能够解析强烈重叠的衍射峰，定量分析一种含五种物相的古埃及化妆品，跟踪运行中电池的晶格演化，并比较无序氧化物催化剂中的原子构型。在DeltaXRDbench上，它在模拟和实验数据的单相与多相识别中领先于所评估的方法。在未提供组成信息时，单相top-1准确率在MP500、RRUFF和opXRD上分别达到96.30\%、81.78\%和40.83\%，而最强比较方法分别为58.00\%、58.47\%和26.45\%。这些结果展示了集成科学工具生态系统如何支持从测量中提取结构知识的智能体，并积累能够迁移到新样品的、经过验证的分析专业能力。

items.title: ddkg.skill: A Compositional Agent Skill for Translating Biomedical and Bioinformatics Questions into Cypher for the Data Distillery Knowledge Graph
items.abstract_or_text: Biomedical knowledge graphs can connect information across genes, phenotypes, tissues, pathways, experiments, and clinical resources, but they are difficult to query correctly without detailed knowledge of the graph. Large language models can help write Cypher code for knowledge graphs, yet a query focused on a bioinformatics task that looks reasonable may still use the wrong identifier, relationship direction, source, intermediate node, or output unit if the user is not completely trained on the schema. We developed ddkg.skill, an Agent Skill that can be loaded into a compatible LLM session to support querying of the NIH Common Fund Data Ecosystem Data Distillery Knowledge Graph (DDKG), a biomedical property graph integrating more than 180 ontologies, over 40 genomics datasets, and dozens of additional cross-domain biomedical datasets. Rather than utilizing a simple markdown prompt, ddkg.skill contains a controller, a compositional library of DDKG-specific references and structured tables, primary documentation, validated query patterns, a routing table, and a Python script that checks the internal links among these materials. The skill build for the December 2025 DDKG release contains 38 bundled files and 239 routing relationships and is identified by checksum so users can state the exact build used to compose a query. The evaluation reported here was performed separately on an earlier build with 38 files and 227 routing entries. In that orthogonal nine-test evaluation against a live December 2025 DDKG instance, five of seven tests targeting sources absent from the worked examples produced correct executed results. The evaluation also exposed a failed query, a cross-source comparison that was not biologically well posed, and errors in the skills own reference material that informed later revisions. The skill guides an AI through entity resolution, graph inspection, query construction, and validation for biomedical and bioinformatics queries, while keeping the DDKG itself as the source of returned results. This design provides a portable and versioned method for giving general-purpose AI systems practical knowledge of a complex biomedical knowledge graph to empower complex bioinformatics data integration. Three executed biomedical use cases further demonstrate cross-species phenotype-to-expression querying, genomic overlap between 4DN chromatin-loop anchors and GTEx eQTLs, and integration of congenital heart phenotype associations with ClinVar and GTEx heart evidence.
items.summary_zh: preprint；提出可加载到兼容 LLM 会话中的 ddkg.skill，用于把生物医学与生物信息学问题转化为可验证的 DDKG Cypher 查询。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 覆盖 180 多个本体、40 多个基因组数据集和多种跨域资源，并提供版本校验、路由表和验证查询；九项正交测试与三个生物医学用例显示其具有实际数据整合价值，但评估也暴露了失败查询和参考资料错误。
items.abstract_zh: 生物医学知识图谱可以连接基因、表型、组织、通路、实验和临床资源的信息，但如果不详细了解图谱，就很难正确查询。大型语言模型可以帮助编写知识图谱的 Cypher 代码，但如果用户没有完全掌握模式，一个看似合理、聚焦于生物信息学任务的查询仍可能使用错误的标识符、关系方向、来源、中间节点或输出单位。我们开发了 ddkg.skill，这是一种 Agent Skill，可加载到兼容的 LLM 会话中，以支持查询 NIH Common Fund Data Ecosystem 的 Data Distillery Knowledge Graph（DDKG）。DDKG 是一个生物医学属性图谱，整合了 180 多个本体、40 多个基因组数据集以及几十个其他跨域生物医学数据集。ddkg.skill 不只是一个简单的 markdown 提示词，而是包含控制器、由 DDKG 专用参考资料和结构化表格组成的组合式库、主要文档、经过验证的查询模式、路由表，以及一个检查这些材料内部链接的 Python 脚本。2025 年 12 月 DDKG 发布版的 skill 构建包含 38 个打包文件和 239 个路由关系，并通过校验和标识，使用户能够声明用于组合查询的确切构建版本。本文报告的评估是在一个较早构建版本上独立进行的，该版本包含 38 个文件和 227 个路由条目。针对一个在线的 2025 年 12 月 DDKG 实例进行的九项正交测试中，面向示例中未出现来源的 7 项测试有 5 项产生了正确的执行结果。评估还暴露出一个失败查询、一个在生物学上并不适当的跨来源比较，以及 skill 自身参考材料中的错误，这些发现推动了后续修订。该 skill 引导 AI 完成实体解析、图谱检查、查询构建和验证，同时让 DDKG 本身作为返回结果的来源。这种设计为通用 AI 系统提供了一种可移植、版本化的方法，使其具备复杂生物医学知识图谱的实用知识，从而支持复杂的生物信息学数据整合。三个已执行的生物医学用例进一步展示了跨物种表型到表达的查询、4DN 染色质环锚点与 GTEx eQTL 的基因组重叠，以及先天性心脏表型关联与 ClinVar 和 GTEx 心脏证据的整合。

items.title: Multimodal Deep Learning for Drug–Drug Interaction Prediction using Structural Biological and Semantic Information
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Drug–drug interactions are a major source of adverse drug events and represent a significant challenge for medication safety and clinical decision-making. Although experimental methods provide reliable evidence for DDI identification, they are often costly, time-consuming, and unable to keep pace with the rapidly increasing number of approved drugs and potential drug combinations. Recent advances in machine learning have enabled large-scale computational prediction of DDIs; however, effectively integrating heterogeneous drug information remains a key challenge. To address this limitation, we propose HySEAtt-DDI, a multimodal deep learning framework for DDI prediction that integrates chemical, biological, and semantic drug information. The proposed framework combines structural similarity derived from molecular fingerprints, biological similarity obtained from drug–protein interaction profiles, and semantic similarity extracted from drug descriptions using BioGPT. These complementary representations are fused into a unified feature space and compressed through an autoencoder to learn compact latent representations. A hybrid architecture consisting of convolutional neural networks (CNNs), Squeeze-and-Excitation blocks, and multi-head self-attention is then employed to capture local patterns, channel-wise feature importance, and long-range dependencies associated with drug interactions. In addition, we construct a curated DrugBank-derived dataset containing 2,148 approved small-molecule drugs, 2,056 protein targets, and 592,840 drug–drug interaction instances. Extensive experiments and ablation studies demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework and highlight the contribution of each modality 1 and architectural component. The results show that HySEAtt-DDI consistently outperforms conventional machine learning methods and competitive deep learning baselines, demonstrating the value of multimodal representation learning for DDI prediction. Overall, the proposed framework provides an effective and scal-able approach for identifying potential drug–drug interactions and supporting computational pharmacology research.
items.summary_zh: preprint；HySEAtt-DDI 融合化学结构、生物相互作用和语义信息预测药物—药物相互作用。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 数据集包含 2,148 个批准小分子药物、2,056 个蛋白靶点和 592,840 个相互作用实例，并有消融实验支持多模态设计；结果仍属于计算预测，不能替代实验或临床验证。
items.abstract_zh: 药物—药物相互作用是药物不良事件的主要来源，也是用药安全和临床决策面临的重要挑战。尽管实验方法能够为 DDI 识别提供可靠证据，但它们通常成本高、耗时长，无法跟上获批药物和潜在药物组合数量的快速增长。近年来机器学习的发展已经支持大规模 DDI 计算预测；然而，有效整合异质药物信息仍然是关键挑战。为解决这一局限，我们提出 HySEAtt-DDI，这是一种整合化学、生物学和语义药物信息的多模态深度学习框架。该框架结合了由分子指纹得到的结构相似性、由药物—蛋白质相互作用谱得到的生物学相似性，以及使用 BioGPT 从药物描述中提取的语义相似性。这些互补表示被融合到统一特征空间中，并通过自编码器压缩，以学习紧凑的潜在表示。随后采用由卷积神经网络（CNN）、Squeeze-and-Excitation 模块和多头自注意力组成的混合架构，用于捕捉与药物相互作用相关的局部模式、通道级特征重要性和长程依赖。此外，我们构建了一个经过整理、来源于 DrugBank 的数据集，其中包含 2,148 个获批小分子药物、2,056 个蛋白质靶点和 592,840 个药物—药物相互作用实例。广泛的实验和消融研究证明了该框架的有效性，并突出了各个模态和架构组件的贡献。结果显示，HySEAtt-DDI 持续优于传统机器学习方法和具有竞争力的深度学习基线，表明多模态表示学习对 DDI 预测具有价值。总体而言，该框架为识别潜在药物—药物相互作用和支持计算药理学研究提供了一种有效且可扩展的方法。

items.title: pre-miRBench: a multispecies benchmark and reference model for animal precursor microRNA prediction
items.abstract_or_text: Motivation: Precursor microRNA (pre-miRNA) prediction is used to prioritize genomic hairpins for miRNA annotation. Published predictors are trained and evaluated on different species collections, negative sets and data partitions, making reported gains difficult to compare. Results: We introduce pre-miRBench, a benchmark of 7,056 200-nt windows centered on curated pre-miRNA loci and 70,560 genomic negatives with predicted hairpin structures from 71 animal species, with a fixed 1:10 positive-to-negative ratio in every partition. Four test sets cross whether the species and miRNA family are represented in training: known species/known family, known species/held-out family, held-out species/known family, and held-out species/held-out family. We retrained six published pre-miRNA predictors (DeepMir, deepMiRGene, dnnPreMiR, mirDNN, miRe2e and MuStARD) under the same benchmark splits and evaluated them alongside the pre-miRBench model, an ensemble of three neural networks developed with Agentomics, an autonomous LLM-agent system for biomedical machine learning. The pre-miRBench model achieved the highest mean average precision (AP) across the four test sets (0.9809; dnnPreMiR, 0.9719) and led three tests. The two held-out species were Gallus gallus and Drosophila melanogaster, and the joint species-and-family holdout contained 69 positives and 690 negatives. dnnPreMiR had the highest AP on the joint species-and-family holdout (0.9677 versus 0.9659). The AP difference (pre-miRBench minus dnnPreMiR) was -0.0018, with a paired bootstrap 95% confidence interval of -0.0445 to 0.0341. pre-miRBench establishes a common evaluation for species and miRNA-family holdouts and provides a reproducible reference model for future comparisons. Availability and implementation: Reproducible source code is available at https://github.com/dimostzim/pre-miRBench. Datasets, trained model weights, record-level predictions, evaluation metrics and species-panel metadata for pre-miRBench and the six retrained predictors are available at https://zenodo.org/records/22813044.
items.summary_zh: preprint；pre-miRBench 统一了 71 个动物物种的前体 miRNA 预测基准，并提供可复现参考模型。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 固定正负比例、物种与 miRNA 家族交叉留出测试、重训六个既有预测器，并公开代码、权重和逐记录预测，显著改善了跨研究比较与复现条件；优势在联合留出测试中并非绝对。
items.abstract_zh: 动​​物前体 microRNA（pre-miRNA）预测用于优先筛选基因组发夹结构，以进行 miRNA 注释。已发表的预测器使用不同的物种集合、负集和数据划分进行训练与评估，因此报告的性能提升难以比较。我们提出 pre-miRBench，这是一个包含 7,056 个 200-nt 窗口和 70,560 个基因组负样本的基准；这些窗口以整理后的 pre-miRNA 位点为中心，负样本来自 71 个动物物种的预测发夹结构。每个分区均采用固定的 1:10 阳性样本对阴性样本比例。四个测试集交叉考察物种和 miRNA 家族是否出现在训练集中：已知物种/已知家族、已知物种/留出家族、留出物种/已知家族，以及留出物种/留出家族。我们在相同的基准划分下重新训练了六个已发表的 pre-miRNA 预测器（DeepMir、deepMiRGene、dnnPreMiR、mirDNN、miRe2e 和 MuStARD），并将它们与 pre-miRBench 模型一起评估；后者是使用 Agentomics（一种用于生物医学机器学习的自主 LLM-agent 系统）开发的三个神经网络的集成模型。pre-miRBench 模型在四个测试集上的平均平均精确率（AP）最高（0.9809；dnnPreMiR 为 0.9719），并在其中三个测试中领先。两个留出物种是 Gallus gallus 和 Drosophila melanogaster；物种与家族联合留出集包含 69 个阳性样本和 690 个阴性样本。在物种与家族联合留出测试中，dnnPreMiR 的 AP 最高（0.9677，而 pre-miRBench 为 0.9659）。AP 差异（pre-miRBench 减去 dnnPreMiR）为 -0.0018，配对 bootstrap 95% 置信区间为 -0.0445 至 0.0341。pre-miRBench 建立了针对物种和 miRNA 家族留出的共同评估框架，并为未来比较提供了可复现的参考模型。可用性与实现：可复现源代码见 https://github.com/dimostzim/pre-miRBench；pre-miRBench 和六个重训预测器的数据集、训练模型权重、逐记录预测、评估指标及物种面板元数据见 https://zenodo.org/records/22813044。
items.author_line: Tzimotoudis, D., Chatzitolios, V. K., Alexiou, P., Georgakilas, G.

items.title: MedZERO: Self-Evolving Agents for Open-Ended Medical Reasoning Through Controlled Knowledge Accumulation
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in medical question answering and clinical reasoning, yet their improvement remains constrained by static parametric knowledge and costly expert supervision. Self-evolving agents offer a promising alternative by enabling models to improve through iterative task generation and problem-solving. However, most existing self-evolving methods are designed for easily verifiable domains such as mathematics and coding, where solutions can be checked by exact answers or executable programs. Medical reasoning is fundamentally different: it is open-ended, knowledge-intensive, and often only partially verifiable. We present MedZERO, a self-evolving framework for open-ended medical reasoning. MedZERO couples an Examiner that generates frontier medical question-option pairs with a Reasoner that solves them through evidence-grounded multi-turn reasoning with external knowledge tools. To support reliable, continual improvement, MedZERO adopts controlled knowledge accumulation, which maintains temporary exploratory knowledge and curated persistent knowledge in reasoning. We evaluate MedZERO on five public medical reasoning benchmarks using 4B- and 8B-scale base models under open-ended evaluation. Across all settings, MedZERO consistently outperforms the underlying base models and prior self-evolving baselines, achieving up to 13.7 average accuracy-point gains over the next-best self-evolving baseline.
items.summary_zh: preprint；MedZERO 通过 Examiner—Reasoner 双组件和受控知识积累，针对开放式医学推理进行自我演化。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在五个公开医学推理基准、4B 和 8B 基础模型上均优于基础模型和既有自演化基线，最高提升 13.7 个平均准确率百分点；评估仍基于基准任务而非临床部署。
items.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）已经在医学问答和临床推理中显示出潜力，但其改进受到静态参数化知识和昂贵专家监督的限制。自我演化智能体通过迭代生成任务和解决问题，使模型能够持续改进，因此提供了一种有希望的替代方案。然而，现有大多数自我演化方法都是为数学和编码等易于验证的领域设计的，在这些领域中，解决方案可以通过精确答案或可执行程序进行检查。医学推理则有根本不同：它是开放式、知识密集型的，并且通常只能得到部分验证。我们提出 MedZERO，一种面向开放式医学推理的自我演化框架。MedZERO 将 Examiner 与 Reasoner 结合起来：Examiner 生成前沿医学问题—选项对，Reasoner 则借助外部知识工具，通过基于证据的多轮推理来解决这些问题。为支持可靠、持续的改进，MedZERO 采用受控知识积累，在推理过程中维护临时探索性知识和经过整理的持久性知识。我们在五个公开医学推理基准上，使用 4B 和 8B 规模的基础模型进行开放式评估。在所有设置中，MedZERO 都持续优于底层基础模型和既有自我演化基线，相比下一个最佳自我演化基线，平均准确率最高提升 13.7 个百分点。
items.author_line: Xilin Dang, Weilin Ruan, Xue Yang, Jinghao Wang, Xiaowei Hu, Jinpeng Li, Pheng-Ann Heng

items.title: Limitations of Genomic Foundation Models for Decoding Regulatory Mechanisms in ALS
items.abstract_or_text: Genomic foundation models promise to infer regulatory consequences of genetic variants directly from DNA sequence, but how well these predictions translate to clinical utility remains unclear. To probe this question, we evaluate AlphaGenome (AG) for understanding amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) genetics without any disease-specific fine-tuning across three settings of increasing difficulty: recovering measured variant effects, reconstructing a known splicing mechanism, and generating de novo regulatory hypotheses at unresolved loci. At population scale, AG failed to recover measured effect sizes across 1,254 spinal-cord splicing quantitative trait loci (QTL) (Spearman = 0.041, Pearson = 0.104) and was precise only at negligible recall (precision = 1.00 at 1.3% recall). At a mechanistically resolved locus of UNC13A cryptic-exon event, AG predicted the intronic risk variant's splice-site usage opposite its known risk effect (Delta approx. -2 x 10^-6), showed near-identical effects in disease-relevant and disease-irrelevant tissues (cerebellar effects reached approximately 60% of neural magnitude), and recovered only a partial cis-regulatory signature. Finally, AG showed limited gene-level resolution across seven ALS genome-wide association study (GWAS) loci, with predicted effects declining sharply as a gene lay farther from the variant (a 10-fold increase in distance cost 0.95 standard deviations of signal; p = 2.7 x 10^-23). In summary, AG can identify a small set of high-confidence regulatory variants, but cannot reliably rank variants by biological effect, or assign regulatory signals to the correct effector gene at unresolved loci. Thus, although AG captures meaningful local regulatory effects, these predictions do not resolve the effect sizes and effector genes needed to connect ALS-associated variants to their causal mechanisms.
items.summary_zh: preprint；系统评估 AlphaGenome 在 ALS 调控机制解析中的能力，显示其在效应大小排序和效应基因归因方面存在明显局限。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究用 1,254 个脊髓剪接 QTL、已解析的 UNC13A 位点和 7 个 ALS GWAS 位点检验模型，结果提醒不能把基因组基础模型的局部预测能力直接等同于临床可用性或因果机制解析。
items.abstract_zh: 基因组基础模型有望直接从 DNA 序列推断遗传变异的调控后果，但这些预测在多大程度上能够转化为临床效用仍不清楚。为探究这一问题，我们在不进行疾病特异性微调的情况下，从三个难度递增的场景评估 AlphaGenome（AG）理解肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）遗传学的能力：恢复实测变异效应、重建已知剪接机制，以及在尚未解析的位点生成新的调控假设。在群体规模分析中，AG 未能恢复 1,254 个脊髓剪接数量性状位点（QTL）的实测效应大小（Spearman = 0.041，Pearson = 0.104），并且只有在召回率极低时才具有精确性（召回率为 1.3% 时 precision = 1.00）。在机制已经解析的 UNC13A 隐匿外显子事件位点，AG 对内含子风险变异剪接位点使用的预测方向与已知风险效应相反（Delta 约为 -2 x 10^-6），在疾病相关和疾病无关组织中显示出几乎相同的效应（小脑效应达到神经组织效应幅度的约 60%），并且只恢复了部分顺式调控特征。最后，在 7 个 ALS 全基因组关联研究（GWAS）位点上，AG 的基因层面分辨率有限：随着基因距离变异越远，预测效应急剧下降（距离增加 10 倍会使信号损失 0.95 个标准差；p = 2.7 x 10^-23）。总之，AG 能够识别少量高置信度调控变异，但不能可靠地按生物学效应对变异排序，也不能在尚未解析的位点把调控信号分配给正确的效应基因。因此，尽管 AG 捕捉到了有意义的局部调控效应，但这些预测并不能解析将 ALS 相关变异连接到其因果机制所需的效应大小和效应基因。
items.author_line: Talukder, A., Kaplan, A.

items.title: Diffusion-Based Inference for Heterogeneous Multichannel Fluorescence Imaging
items.abstract_or_text: Fluorescence microscopy is a central tool in biomedical image analysis, but its practical use is often constrained by incomplete and heterogeneous data. This is especially true in rare disease research, where patient cohorts are small, biological material is limited, and complex study designs frequently yield images with missing, degraded, or low-quality channels. We introduce Reliability-Mask-Conditioned DDPM (RM-DDPM), a conditional diffusion model that formulates multichannel image generation, missing-channel imputation, and degraded-channel restoration as a single reliability-guided inference problem. The model is trained on a curated subset of complete, high-quality multichannel images using a self-supervised masking objective to learn rich cross-channel dependencies from the available channels. At inference time, reliable observations condition the reverse diffusion process, allowing the same trained model to solve multiple reconstruction tasks without task-specific retraining. We evaluate RM-DDPM against task-specific baselines on one public and two in-house fluorescence microscopy datasets, comprising a rare-disease preclinical model study and a clinical patient cohort. Across these settings, RM-DDPM matches the specialized baselines in reconstruction quality, hallucinates fewer false structures, and remains more robust as degradation severity increases, while repeated sampling provides per-pixel uncertainty maps that flag unreliable reconstructions.
items.summary_zh: preprint；RM-DDPM 将多通道荧光图像生成、缺失通道补全和退化通道恢复统一为可靠性掩码条件扩散推断。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在一个公开数据集和两个内部数据集（包括罕见病临床队列）上与专用基线比较，模型保持重建质量并减少虚假结构，还能通过重复采样提供像素级不确定性；结果仍需更广泛外部验证。
items.abstract_zh: 荧光显微镜是生物医学图像分析的核心工具，但其实际应用常受到数据不完整和异质性的限制。在罕见病研究中尤其如此，因为患者队列较小、生物材料有限，复杂的研究设计经常会产生缺失、退化或低质量通道的图像。我们提出 Reliability-Mask-Conditioned DDPM（RM-DDPM），一种条件扩散模型，将多通道图像生成、缺失通道补全和退化通道恢复统一表述为一个由可靠性引导的推断问题。模型使用经过整理的完整、高质量多通道图像子集进行训练，并采用自监督掩码目标，从可用通道中学习丰富的跨通道依赖。在推断时，可靠观测会对反向扩散过程提供条件，使同一个训练模型无需针对任务重新训练就能解决多种重建任务。我们在一个公开荧光显微镜数据集和两个内部数据集上，将 RM-DDPM 与面向特定任务的基线进行比较；这些数据集包括一个罕见病临床前模型研究和一个临床患者队列。在这些设置中，RM-DDPM 的重建质量与专用基线相当，产生的虚假结构更少，并且在退化程度增加时保持更强的鲁棒性；重复采样还可以提供逐像素不确定性图，用于标记不可靠的重建结果。

items.title: MetagenomicsBench: A Verifiable Benchmark for Agentic Metagenomics Analysis
items.abstract_or_text: Metagenomics has transformed our ability to characterize microbial communities without relying on cultivation, but translating complex microbiome datasets into reliable biological conclusions remains a major analytical challenge. Although AI agents have improved substantially at software engineering and general data analysis, it remains unclear whether they can reliably analyze and interpret real-world metagenomic data. We introduce MetagenomicsBench, a benchmark of 100 verifiable evaluations derived from published datasets spanning community structure, host-microbiome associations, microbial function, longitudinal dynamics, and microbiome interventions. Each evaluation provides experimental data and a deterministic grader that evaluates recovery of a key analytical or biological result. Across 10,200 trajectories from 34 model-harness configurations, the strongest configuration achieved a 60.0% pass rate. Performance varied across functional domains, data modalities, and biological systems, while greater cost, token usage, and tool use did not consistently correspond to higher accuracy. Trajectory analysis showed that agents often produced technically plausible analyses while making mistakes in problem interpretation, statistical reasoning, and biological interpretation. MetagenomicsBench provides a framework for measuring progress toward AI agents that can reliably make and validate the analytical and biological decisions required for metagenomic research.
items.summary_zh: preprint；MetagenomicsBench 用可确定评分器评估智能体在真实宏基因组数据上的分析与生物学解释可靠性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 100 个可验证评估覆盖群落结构、宿主—微生物组关联、微生物功能、纵向动态和干预；10,200 条轨迹显示最强配置通过率仅 60.0%，并揭示技术上看似合理的分析仍可能在问题理解、统计推理和生物学解释上出错。
items.abstract_zh: 宏基因组学使我们能够在不依赖培养的情况下表征微生物群落，但将复杂的微生物组数据转化为可靠的生物学结论仍是重大的分析挑战。尽管 AI 智能体在软件工程和一般数据分析方面已经取得显著进步，但它们能否可靠地分析和解释真实世界的宏基因组数据仍不清楚。我们提出 MetagenomicsBench，这是一个包含 100 个可验证评估的基准，评估来自已发表的数据集，覆盖群落结构、宿主—微生物组关联、微生物功能、纵向动态和微生物组干预。每项评估都提供实验数据和一个确定性评分器，用于评价是否恢复了关键的分析或生物学结果。在来自 34 种模型—工具框架配置的 10,200 条轨迹中，最强配置的通过率为 60.0%。模型表现因功能领域、数据模态和生物学系统而异；更高的成本、token 使用量和工具使用量并不始终对应更高的准确率。轨迹分析显示，智能体经常能够产生技术上看似合理的分析，但会在问题理解、统计推理和生物学解释上犯错。MetagenomicsBench 为衡量 AI 智能体在宏基因组研究中可靠完成并验证分析和生物学决策方面的进展提供了框架。
items.author_line: Yang, Z., Connolly, J., Banerjee, A., Madad, S.

items.title: Cite What You Explore: Budget-Aware LLM Reasoning over Medical KGs with Verifiable Evidence
items.abstract_or_text: Post-discharge risk prediction from electronic health records (EHRs) is difficult because many dependencies that link discharge-time observations to downstream complications, such as comorbidity cascades and drug-disease interactions, are absent from the record. External medical knowledge graphs (KGs) can supply these missing dependencies, but tracing them demands three properties: KG exploration must remain cost-bounded, retrieved evidence must be differentiated by source quality, and the resulting rationale must be citable for retrospective review. Large language models (LLMs) can plan and verify over structured evidence, making them natural candidates for KG reasoning, but existing LLM-based methods do not satisfy these three properties jointly. In this paper, we propose BAR, a Budget-Aware LLM Reasoning framework over medical KGs with three contributions. First, BAR refines the raw KG into disease-specific evidence graphs whose edges carry support scores and provenance records, turning the KG into a quality-annotated reasoning space rather than a static feature source. Second, an LLM then reasons over this graph through a plan-navigate-verify loop that decomposes the question into steps, retrieves evidence under a patient-specific budget, and revises when verification fails. Third, a reasoning policy is trained with a reward that compares predictions with and without acquired evidence, combined with acquisition cost and citation-integrity terms. Across 8 diseases and 3 prediction horizons on MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV, BAR improves AUPRC by 3.4 points over the strongest baseline, raises citation precision from 59.8% to 77.9%, and consumes only 62-65% of the budget cap.
items.summary_zh: preprint；BAR 在医疗知识图谱上执行有预算约束、带来源证据和可引用理由的 LLM 推理，用于出院后风险预测。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在 MIMIC-III 和 MIMIC-IV 的 8 种疾病、3 个预测时间窗上，AUPRC 提升 3.4 个百分点、引用精确率由 59.8% 升至 77.9%，且仅使用预算上限的 62–65%；这是回顾性数据上的方法学证据。
items.abstract_zh: 出院后风险预测很困难，因为将出院时观测与后续并发症连接起来的许多依赖关系，例如合并症级联和药物—疾病相互作用，并不存在于病历记录中。外部医学知识图谱可以补充这些缺失的依赖关系，但追踪它们需要满足三个条件：知识图谱探索必须保持成本有界，检索到的证据必须按来源质量区分，所得理由必须能够引用，以便进行回顾性审查。大型语言模型能够在结构化证据上进行规划和验证，因此自然适合知识图谱推理；但现有基于 LLM 的方法尚未同时满足这三个条件。我们提出 BAR，一种面向医学知识图谱的 Budget-Aware LLM Reasoning 框架，包含三项贡献。第一，BAR 将原始知识图谱细化为疾病特异性证据图，使边携带支持分数和来源记录，将知识图谱从静态特征来源转变为带质量标注的推理空间。第二，LLM 通过 plan—navigate—verify 循环在该图上进行推理，将问题分解为多个步骤，在患者特异性预算下检索证据，并在验证失败时进行修订。第三，训练一个推理策略，其奖励同时比较获取证据前后的预测，并结合获取成本和引用完整性项。在 MIMIC-III 和 MIMIC-IV 上针对 8 种疾病和 3 个预测时间窗进行评估时，BAR 相比最强基线将 AUPRC 提高了 3.4 个百分点，将引用精确率从 59.8% 提高到 77.9%，并且只消耗预算上限的 62–65%。

items.title: Temporally validated clinical trial outcome prediction from public registry text: a leakage-audited comparison of biomedical transformers and classical NLP
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Background: Public clinical trial registries contain information about study design, populations, interventions, and endpoints that may help predict trial outcomes. This study evaluated whether a language model trained using automated Clinical Trial Outcome Dataset (CTOD) probabilities as its only training labels could predict neuroscience trial outcomes. Methods: Phase-specific models were trained on ClinicalTrials.gov records for trials completed before 2019 across all indications. CTOD probabilities were used as continuous training labels, and models were evaluated on post-2019 neuroscience trials using CTOD’s manually curated 2020–2024 outcomes. Inputs were limited to 16 public registry fields, excluding identifiers, dates, status and results modules, the derived CombinedPhases field, and targets. Fixed rules removed explicit descriptions of trial results. BioBERT was selected in a Phase 2 pilot and fixed as the primary model, with BiomedBERT and three matched term frequency–inverse document frequency (TF-IDF) baselines as comparators. Phase 2 remained developmental because its pilot human-reference outcomes had been inspected. Predictions were averaged across five seeds, and uncertainty was estimated from 5,000 bootstrap samples of unique trials. Results: Evaluation included 939 Phase 1, 1,047 Phase 2, and 681 Phase 3 trials. BioBERT achieved areas under the receiver operating characteristic curve (ROC-AUC) of 0.669 (95% confidence interval 0.626 to 0.712), 0.708 (0.675 to 0.741), and 0.719 (0.678 to 0.758), respectively. Corresponding areas under the precision-recall curve (PR-AUC) were 0.431, 0.585, and 0.760, compared with outcome prevalence of 0.230, 0.365, and 0.602. In Phase 3, BiomedBERT reached ROC-AUC 0.745, exceeding BioBERT by 0.027 (Holm-adjusted p=0.026), while the soft-label logistic model reached 0.744. BioBERT Brier skill was negative in Phases 1 and 2 and positive in Phase 3. The full experiment took 3.5 hours on one RTX 5000 Ada graphics processing unit (GPU), at a recorded GPU cost of US1.19. Conclusions: Training on automated CTOD labels was sufficient to support outcome ranking in later trials using public registry text. Publicly available data allow researchers to reproduce the approach with modest computing resources and without subscription trial databases.
items.summary_zh: preprint；对公共临床试验注册文本进行时间外验证，比较 BioBERT、BiomedBERT 与 TF-IDF 模型预测神经科学试验结局的能力。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 使用 939、1,047 和 681 个分别处于 Phase 1、2、3 的试验，并排除结果泄漏字段；模型可用普通公开数据和一块 RTX 5000 Ada GPU 复现，但预测能力为中等且 Phase 2 仍属开发性评估。
items.abstract_zh: 公共临床试验注册库包含研究设计、受试人群、干预措施和终点等信息，这些信息可能有助于预测试验结局。本研究评估了仅使用自动生成的 Clinical Trial Outcome Dataset（CTOD）概率作为训练标签的语言模型，能否预测神经科学试验结局。模型使用所有适应证中 2019 年之前完成的 ClinicalTrials.gov 记录进行分阶段训练，并使用 CTOD 人工整理的 2020–2024 年结局，在 2019 年之后的神经科学试验上进行评估。输入限制为 16 个公共注册字段，排除了标识符、日期、状态和结果模块、派生的 CombinedPhases 字段以及目标变量。固定规则移除了对试验结果的明确描述。Phase 2 试点选择 BioBERT，并将其固定为主要模型；比较模型包括 BiomedBERT 和三个匹配的词频—逆文档频率（TF-IDF）基线。由于试点阶段检查过人工参考结局，Phase 2 仍属于开发性阶段。预测结果取五个随机种子的平均值，不确定性通过 5,000 个以独立试验为单位的 bootstrap 样本估计。评估包括 939 个 Phase 1、1,047 个 Phase 2 和 681 个 Phase 3 试验。BioBERT 的 ROC-AUC 分别为 0.669（95% 置信区间 0.626 至 0.712）、0.708（0.675 至 0.741）和 0.719（0.678 至 0.758）。相应的 PR-AUC 为 0.431、0.585 和 0.760，而结局发生率分别为 0.230、0.365 和 0.602。在 Phase 3 中，BiomedBERT 的 ROC-AUC 达到 0.745，比 BioBERT 高 0.027（Holm 校正 p=0.026）；软标签逻辑模型达到 0.744。BioBERT 的 Brier skill 在 Phase 1 和 Phase 2 为负，在 Phase 3 为正。完整实验在一块 RTX 5000 Ada 图形处理单元（GPU）上耗时 3.5 小时，记录 GPU 成本为 US1.19。结论：使用自动 CTOD 标签进行训练，足以支持利用公共注册文本对后续试验进行结局排序。公开数据使研究者能够在不使用订阅制试验数据库、且计算资源适中的条件下复现该方法。

items.title: Translational relevance of Telomeric C-circles in Cancer: from Experimental Research to Potential Clinical Applications
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Alternative lengthening of telomeres (ALT) is a recombination-based telomere maintenance mechanism that sustains replicative immortality in approximately 10–15% of human cancers, particularly those of mesenchymal and neuroepithelial origin. As precision oncology increasingly demands biomarkers that accurately define telomere maintenance mechanisms, extrachromosomal telomeric C-circles - partially single-stranded, C-rich telomeric circular DNAs - have emerged as robust, quantifiable indicators of ALT activity with growing diagnostic, prognostic, and therapeutic relevance. Here, we summarize recent mechanistic and translational advances that establish C-circles as both functional readouts of ALT biology and clinically actionable biomarkers. We integrate emerging evidence into a unified model in which replication stress drives C-circle biogenesis through two complementary replication-coupled pathways that are dynamically shaped by telomeric DNA structures and DNA repair factors, linking the molecular origins of C-circle formation to specific vulnerabilities with direct therapeutic implications. We further critically evaluate current detection technologies, spanning the gold-standard C-circle assay and its quantitative PCR and high-throughput adaptations and single-cell native FISH, which collectively enable sensitive and scalable detection across tissue specimens and liquid biopsies, including exosome-protected C-circles. Clinically, C-circles outperform surrogate genomic markers such as ATRX/DAXX loss for defining ALT status, improve prognostic stratification across pediatric brain tumors, diffuse gliomas, sarcomas, and other ALT-associated malignancies, and show considerable promise as dynamic pharmacodynamic biomarkers for treatment monitoring, minimal residual disease assessment, and longitudinal disease surveillance. Therapeutically, the molecular circuitry underlying C-circle biogenesis exposes selective ALT dependencies on replication stress and DNA repair regulators, including the BLM/BTR and FANCM pathways. Perturbation of these nodes reshapes C-circle dynamics while revealing synthetic lethal vulnerabilities that can be exploited through helicase-, nuclease-, chromatin-, replication stress-, and G-quadruplex-targeted strategies. We also discuss the important caveat that telomerase-positive tumors with hyperextended telomeres can generate C-circles, emphasizing the need for cautious interpretation of C-circle measurements. Collectively, C-circles have evolved from experimental hallmarks of ALT into mechanistically informative and clinically actionable biomarkers. Continued assay standardization and integration into tissue and liquid biopsy workflows will facilitate their application in diagnosis, patient stratification, therapeutic monitoring, and biomarker-driven clinical studies.
items.summary_zh: preprint；综述端粒 C-circles 在 ALT 肿瘤中的形成机制、检测技术及潜在诊断、预后和药效监测用途。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 整合机制研究、组织与液体活检检测、儿童脑瘤和肉瘤等临床证据，同时明确指出端粒酶阳性且端粒过度延长的肿瘤也可能产生 C-circles，强调生物标志物解释需要谨慎。
items.abstract_zh: 替代性端粒延长（ALT）是一种基于重组的端粒维持机制，可维持约 10–15% 人类癌症的复制永生性，尤其见于间充质和神经上皮来源的肿瘤。随着精准肿瘤学越来越需要能够准确界定端粒维持机制的生物标志物，染色体外端粒 C-circles——部分单链、富含 C 的端粒环状 DNA——已经成为 ALT 活性的稳健、可定量指标，并日益显示出诊断、预后和治疗相关性。在本文中，我们总结了近期机制和转化研究进展，这些进展将 C-circles 确立为 ALT 生物学的功能性读出和具有临床可操作性的生物标志物。我们将新出现的证据整合为一个统一模型：复制压力通过两条互补的、与复制偶联的通路驱动 C-circle 形成，而这些通路受到端粒 DNA 结构和 DNA 修复因子的动态塑造，从而把 C-circle 形成的分子起源与具有直接治疗意义的特定脆弱性联系起来。我们还批判性地评估了当前的检测技术，包括金标准 C-circle 检测及其定量 PCR 和高通量改良方法，以及单细胞原位 FISH；这些技术共同支持在组织标本和液体活检中灵敏、可扩展地检测 C-circles，其中也包括受外泌体保护的 C-circles。在临床上，与 ATRX/DAXX 缺失等替代性基因组标志物相比，C-circles 在界定 ALT 状态方面表现更好；它们改善了儿童脑瘤、弥漫性胶质瘤、肉瘤和其他 ALT 相关恶性肿瘤的预后分层，并且作为治疗监测、微小残留病评估和纵向疾病监测的动态药效学标志物显示出相当大的潜力。在治疗方面，C-circle 形成的分子回路揭示了 ALT 对复制压力和 DNA 修复调控因子的选择性依赖，包括 BLM/BTR 和 FANCM 通路。扰动这些节点会改变 C-circle 动态，同时揭示可利用的合成致死脆弱性，可以通过靶向解旋酶、核酸酶、染色质、复制压力和 G-quadruplex 的策略加以利用。我们还讨论了一个重要注意事项：端粒酶阳性且端粒过度延长的肿瘤也能够产生 C-circles，这强调了谨慎解释 C-circle 测量结果的必要性。总体而言，C-circles 已经从 ALT 的实验性标志物发展为具有机制信息和临床可操作性的生物标志物。持续推进检测标准化，并将其整合到组织和液体活检工作流中，将有助于其应用于诊断、患者分层、治疗监测和生物标志物驱动的临床研究。
items.author_line: Folini M, Pasquali S, Zaffaroni N

items.title: Gastric cancer-specific neuroinflammation-related genes with prognostic significance: scRNA-seq with bulk RNA-seq data and experimental validation
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Gastric cancer (GC) is a heterogeneous malignancy with poor outcomes, and reliable biomarkers are needed to improve prognosis assessment and individualized treatment. Neuroinflammation-related genes (NIRGs) may reflect neural-immune interactions within the tumor microenvironment (TME), but their prognostic value in GC remains unclear. This study integrated bulk RNA sequencing data from The Cancer Genome Atlas-stomach adenocarcinoma (TCGA-STAD) and Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) with single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data to identify NIRG-related prognostic features. Differential expression analysis, non-negative matrix factorization (NMF), Cox regression, and a random survival forest (RSF) model identified five prognostic genes: GRIA3, NGF, SLC17A7, TGFB2, and TGFB3. The risk model stratified patients by overall survival (OS) and showed validation performance in an independent cohort. The risk score was associated with clinicopathological characteristics, immune infiltration, and predicted drug sensitivity. Functional analyses linked these genes to stemness, invasion, and epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT). scRNA-seq analysis highlighted fibroblasts as key cells involved in NIRG-related TME remodeling, and reverse transcription-quantitative polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR) validated GRIA3, NGF, and SLC17A7 expression. These findings provide a potential prognostic framework for GC.
items.summary_zh: preprint；整合 TCGA、GEO 和 scRNA-seq 数据，并用 RT-qPCR 验证胃癌神经炎症相关预后基因。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 风险模型涉及 GRIA3、NGF、SLC17A7、TGFB2 和 TGFB3，单细胞分析指向成纤维细胞在相关肿瘤微环境重塑中的作用；目前仍是独立队列验证和实验验证支持的预后关联框架。
items.abstract_zh: 胃癌（GC）是一种异质性恶性肿瘤，预后较差，因此需要可靠的生物标志物来改善预后评估和个体化治疗。神经炎症相关基因（NIRG）可能反映肿瘤微环境（TME）中的神经—免疫相互作用，但其在 GC 中的预后价值仍不清楚。本研究整合了来自 The Cancer Genome Atlas-stomach adenocarcinoma（TCGA-STAD）和 Gene Expression Omnibus（GEO）的 bulk RNA 测序数据，以及单细胞 RNA 测序（scRNA-seq）数据，以识别 NIRG 相关的预后特征。差异表达分析、非负矩阵分解（NMF）、Cox 回归和随机生存森林（RSF）模型识别出 5 个预后基因：GRIA3、NGF、SLC17A7、TGFB2 和 TGFB3。该风险模型根据总生存期（OS）对患者进行分层，并在独立队列中显示出验证性能。风险评分与临床病理特征、免疫浸润和预测的药物敏感性相关。功能分析将这些基因与干性、侵袭和上皮—间质转化（EMT）联系起来。scRNA-seq 分析强调成纤维细胞是参与 NIRG 相关 TME 重塑的关键细胞；逆转录—定量聚合酶链式反应（RT-qPCR）验证了 GRIA3、NGF 和 SLC17A7 的表达。这些发现提供了一个潜在的胃癌预后框架。
items.author_line: Tao X, Zhou Y, YU S, Kuai X, Zhou C, Wang H

items.title: GeneICL: A Tabular Foundation Model for Bulk Transcriptomics
items.abstract_or_text: Gene expression is widely measured in biomedicine, yet clinical outcome prediction remains challenging due to high dimensionality, strong feature correlations, and limited labeled data. Large self-supervised transcriptomic foundation models often fail to outperform simple supervised baselines. Tabular foundation models offer an alternative through in-context learning, but are typically pretrained on generic synthetic data rather than transcriptomic structure. We ask whether transcriptomics-aware pretraining, rather than scale, is the missing ingredient. Towards this end, we introduce GeneICL, a 4.2M-parameter tabular foundation model combining a semi-synthetic pretraining prior built from measured bulk expression profiles with a parameter-efficient recurrent architecture. We further enable right-censored survival prediction via a training-free reduction to regression using Cox partial-likelihood residuals. We evaluate GeneICL on 80 clinical outcome-prediction tasks spanning classification, regression, and survival. Tabular foundation models consistently outperform self-supervised transcriptomic models, while GeneICL achieves the best overall rank among evaluated foundation models and tuned baselines. GeneICL does so with up to 387\times fewer parameters, no gradient updates at inference, and predictions within seconds on a laptop CPU.
items.summary_zh: preprint；GeneICL 是一个面向 bulk transcriptomics 的 4.2M 参数表格基础模型，以测量表达谱构建半合成预训练先验。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在 80 个临床结局预测任务上，GeneICL 以最多少 387 倍的参数量、无需推理时梯度更新并可在笔记本 CPU 上秒级预测，取得最佳总体排名；其优势来自数据结构适配而非单纯模型规模。
items.abstract_zh: 基因表达在生物医学中被广泛测量，但临床结局预测仍然具有挑战性，原因包括高维性、强特征相关性和标注数据有限。大型自监督转录组基础模型通常无法优于简单的监督式基线。表格基础模型通过上下文学习提供了一种替代方案，但它们通常在通用合成数据上进行预训练，而不是利用转录组结构。我们探讨的问题是：转录组感知的预训练，而非规模，是否才是缺失的关键。为此，我们提出 GeneICL，这是一种 4.2M 参数的表格基础模型，将基于实测 bulk expression profile 构建的半合成预训练先验与参数高效的循环架构相结合。我们还通过一种无需训练的降维方法实现右删失生存预测，该方法使用 Cox 偏似然残差将其转化为回归问题。我们在 80 个临床结局预测任务上进行评估，涵盖分类、回归和生存分析。表格基础模型持续优于自监督转录组模型；在所有评估的基础模型和调优基线中，GeneICL 取得了最佳总体排名。GeneICL 使用最多少 387 倍的参数量实现这一点，推理时无需梯度更新，并且可以在笔记本 CPU 上于数秒内生成预测。
items.author_line: Michael Bohl, Alexander Theus, David Wissel, Valentina Boeva

items.title: Single-Cell Behavioromics Enables Fate Prediction of Individual Hematopoietic Stem Cells
items.abstract_or_text: Achieving near-single-cell precision in the prospective identification of long-term engrafting hematopoietic stem cells (LT-HSCs) remains challenging, likely because current static, point-in-time single-cell phenotyping technologies do not capture the dynamic nature of cell fate decisions. Here, we overcome this barrier by longitudinally tracking individual hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells (HSPCs) in ex vivo niche cultures using live imaging, coupled with downstream immunophenotyping, single-cell transcriptomics, and transplant assays. Deep learning analysis of live imaging data achieved 98.5% average precision in predicting serially-engrafting LT-HSC (serial-LT-HSC) identity from the behaviorome (the totality of observed behaviors) of each cell, outperforming currently available technologies. Serial-LT-HSCs exhibited lower motility among HSPC populations, which was associated with reduced Activin signaling activity and elevated expression of cell adhesion genes. Correspondingly, antagonizing Activin signaling by Inhibin-A treatment in ex vivo niche cultures suppressed HSPC motility while increasing the frequency of post-expansion serial-LT-HSCs, revealing a novel role for Activin signaling in HSPC behavior and fate determination. Collectively, this study establishes a broadly applicable framework that connects behavioromic analysis and single-cell transcriptomics to enable near-single-cell precision in predicting stem cell fate and uncover molecular mechanisms governing behavior-fate relationships.
items.summary_zh: preprint；通过活细胞纵向成像、免疫表型、单细胞转录组和移植实验建立单细胞行为组学，用于预测长期植入型 HSC 命运。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 深度学习从单细胞行为组学预测 serial-LT-HSC 的平均精确率达到 98.5%，并结合 Activin signaling 扰动与移植结果提出行为—命运联系；这是实验性、前瞻性证据，仍需独立队列验证。
items.abstract_zh: 要以前瞻方式、接近单细胞精度地识别能够长期植入的造血干细胞（LT-HSC），仍然具有挑战性，这可能是因为当前静态、单时间点的单细胞表型技术无法捕捉细胞命运决定的动态性质。在这里，我们通过活细胞成像，在体外微环境培养中纵向追踪单个造血干细胞和祖细胞（HSPC），并结合后续免疫表型分析、单细胞转录组学和移植实验，克服了这一障碍。对活细胞成像数据进行深度学习分析后，根据每个细胞的行为组学（所观察到的全部行为）预测连续植入型 LT-HSC（serial-LT-HSC）身份的平均精确率达到 98.5%，优于当前可用技术。与 HSPC 群体中的其他细胞相比，serial-LT-HSC 的运动性更低，这与 Activin signaling 活性降低和细胞黏附基因表达升高相关。相应地，在体外微环境培养中使用 Inhibin-A 拮抗 Activin signaling，抑制了 HSPC 运动性，同时提高了扩增后 serial-LT-HSC 的频率，揭示了 Activin signaling 在 HSPC 行为和命运决定中的一种新作用。总体而言，本研究建立了一个具有广泛适用性的框架，将行为组学分析和单细胞转录组学连接起来，从而以接近单细胞的精度预测干细胞命运，并探索支配行为—命运关系的分子机制。

items.title: MS-ECG-FM: Towards a More Universal Electrocardiogram Foundation Model for Health Monitoring using Multi-source Contrastive Learning
items.abstract_or_text: Electrocardiography (ECG) records the electrical activity of the heart, aiding diagnosis by detecting abnormalities in cardiac function. ECG foundation models have demonstrated promising results, but are limited by a reliance on ECG interpretation reports as their sole supervision. Because interpretation reports only capture the subset of waveform information routinely recognized by clinicians, this constrains representation learning to overlook the broader diagnostic signals present in ECG. We introduce a new ECG foundation model --- MS-ECG-FM --- that is trained through contrastive alignment to multiple distinct clinical note types, including ECG, echocardiography, radiology, and discharge reports. We evaluate MS-ECG-FM on an extended set of ECG detection benchmarks, showing that it comprehensively outperforms existing methods on the full span of conditions that ECG can detect, including in reduced-lead configurations. Different reports improve representations for different diagnostic domains, while multi-source alignment captures their complementary information and produces consistently strong representations across clinically diverse tasks.
items.summary_zh: preprint；MS-ECG-FM 通过对齐 ECG、超声心动图、放射学和出院报告等多种临床文本，训练更通用的 ECG 基础模型。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 多来源对比学习利用不同临床记录的互补信息，在扩展 ECG 检测基准和少导联配置中均优于既有方法；摘要未给出队列规模和具体效应量，因此临床泛化程度仍需核实。
items.abstract_zh: 心电图（ECG）记录心脏的电活动，可通过检测心功能异常辅助诊断。ECG 基础模型已经显示出潜力，但受到仅依赖 ECG 解读报告作为监督信号的限制。由于解读报告只捕捉临床医生通常识别出的那部分波形信息，这种做法会限制表示学习，使其忽略 ECG 中存在的更广泛诊断信号。我们提出一种新的 ECG 基础模型——MS-ECG-FM，通过与多种不同类型的临床记录进行对比对齐来训练，包括 ECG、超声心动图、放射学报告和出院报告。我们在扩展的 ECG 检测基准上评估 MS-ECG-FM，结果显示，它在 ECG 能够检测的全部疾病范围内全面优于现有方法，包括少导联配置。不同类型的报告会改善不同诊断领域的表示，而多来源对齐能够捕捉它们的互补信息，并在临床任务多样的场景中产生持续强劲的表示。
